name: Repo Man
tagline: 4 am on a cul-de-sac: Gary works a checklist while the owner watches through the blinds over a chart that is still green, and every step up the round multiplier unbolted more of the house. The Lambo, the hose, the TV, the kid's bike with a bow on the handlebars. Buy it all back with one confirmed cash-out, or watch Gary take the front door off its hinges.
